name: default
description: Site preferences for Siemens MR protocols. A rule fires only when the parameter it names is actually present, so rules for one sequence type do not report against scans that never had the setting.

rules.reason: Phase scrambling reduces peak RF amplitude in multiband excitation; leaving it off risks SAR limiting and slice leakage.
Shorter excitation pulses raise peak B1 and narrow the slice profile; keep at or above 3000 us.
